title: Coordinate TermAl migration from Beads with enforced evidence and acceptance evaluation
outcome: Coordinate TermAl migration from Beads with enforced evidence and acceptance evaluation
acceptance: All nonclosed TermAl Beads items and retained project memories are accounted for in a verified migration manifest, preserving authored content, hierarchy, dependencies and old-to-new references without fabricating execution claims or historical verification.
Report the migrated counts, configuration, live evidence, remaining limitations and archive location to Greg; do not report cutover complete while a required host capability remains unavailable.

TermAl instructions, commands and hooks use Engram; local Beads data and integration are removed only after migration reconciliation and verification of the GitHub archive, under Greg's explicit deletion authorization.

TermAl's own Engram project has a confirmed store home and host configuration; live checks show host-observed test evidence on the actual task worktree, independent acceptance evaluation and source freshness, and completion refusal for missing, failed or stale required evidence.
